findings.evidence: `pkg/executor/show.go:344` sorts `bindings` and dereferences `bindings[i].UpdateTime` before any nil guard; the nil guard is only in the later loop (`pkg/executor/show.go:352-355`). `pkg/bindinfo/binding_cache.go:338-355` shows `GetAllBindings()` appends `c.GetBinding(sqlDigest)` which returns nil on cache miss (`pkg/bindinfo/binding_cache.go:339-342`), and notes LRU eviction can make cache state inconsistent (`pkg/bindinfo/binding_cache.go:368-370`).
findings.fix: Filter out nil bindings before sorting (or make the sort comparator nil-safe). Also add nil guards for other `GetAllBindings()` consumers like `pkg/executor/show.go:403-406` (`fetchShowBindingCacheStatus`).
findings.impact: If the global binding cache evicts entries (e.g., low `MemQuotaBindingCache` / memory pressure), `SHOW [GLOBAL] BINDINGS` can panic in `sort.Slice`, potentially crashing the session (and depending on panic recovery, risking process instability). `SHOW BINDING_CACHE_STATUS` can also panic when calling `binding.IsBindingEnabled()` on a nil entry.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed on `upstream/master`: `upstream/master:pkg/executor/show.go` still sorts before the nil guard (see `upstream/master:pkg/executor/show.go` around `fetchShowBind`, lines ~333-355 in `git show upstream/master:pkg/executor/show.go`).
findings.verify: Repro idea: set binding cache quota very small, create enough global bindings to trigger eviction, then run `SHOW GLOBAL BINDINGS` and `SHOW BINDING_CACHE_STATUS`; expect no panic and a stable result set (nil entries skipped safely).
findings.what: Potential panic in `SHOW [GLOBAL] BINDINGS` (and related SHOW) when binding cache returns nil entries: nil is checked only after sorting, but `sort.Slice` comparator dereferences binding fields.

subject: planner: support cluster-level binding reload command (#65509)
summary: This commit adds `ADMIN RELOAD CLUSTER BINDINGS` (parser/AST + planner op + executor broadcast plumbing) by broadcasting `ADMIN RELOAD BINDINGS` to all TiDB instances. A High-severity runtime issue remains in the touched executor code: `SHOW [GLOBAL] BINDINGS` can still panic when the binding cache returns nil entries due to eviction, because sorting happens before the nil guard; this is also still present on `upstream/master`.
